## Travel Cancellation Policy — Current as of Q3 2026

### 1. Flight Booking Cancellations

**Free Cancellation Window:**
- **Domestic flights:** Full refund within **24 hours** of booking
- **International flights:** Full refund within **48 hours** of booking

**Cancellation Fees by Cabin Class (after free window):**

| Cabin Class | Route Type | Cancellation Fee |
|---|---|---|
| **Basic Economy** | All | **Not cancellable** after free window (unless travel insurance was purchased) |
| **Economy** | Domestic | **max($50, 15% of ticket price)** |
| **Economy** | International | **max($75, 20% of ticket price)** |
| **Business** | Domestic | **5% of ticket price** |
| **Business** | International | **8% of ticket price** |
| **First Class** | All | **Free cancellation** (no fee) |

**Travel Insurance Override:** Travel insurance covers cancellation regardless of cabin class — if purchased, the cancellation fee is waived.

---

### 2. Hotel Reservation Cancellations

| Room Type | Cancellation Window | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| **Standard Room** | ≥ 48 hours before check-in | **Free cancellation** |
| **Standard Room** | 24–48 hours before check-in | **50% of first night** charged |
| **Standard Room** | < 24 hours before check-in | **Full first night** charged |
| **Suite** | Any time | **Non-refundable** — full charge regardless of timing |

---

### 3. Car Rental Cancellations

| Cancellation Window | Fee |
|---|---|
| ≥ 24 hours before pickup | **Free cancellation** |
| < 24 hours before pickup | **One day's rental charge** |

**Vehicle Surcharge:** Luxury and SUV rentals incur an additional **$50 cancellation surcharge** at all times (even for free-window cancellations).

---

### 4. General Provisions

- Fees differ by **route type** (domestic vs. international) — the flight's route type determines which fee schedule applies.
- All cancellations follow a **two-step process**: a preview of terms is generated first, followed by confirmation to execute.
- Refunds are processed to the **original payment method**.
- Cancelled bookings receive a **"cancelled" status** and cannot be reinstated — a new booking must be created.

---
